subject: stf
title: STF.------PART.
description: Chart on book p. 497 (TRF(II)-33). STF (source transfer) is the subject; PART (participation) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-INVT, AFI (affinity insight) and TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From INFO-INVT: DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). From AFI: IF-SPTL. From IF-SPTL: MOT-DY. From TECH-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From IST-S-ALGN: APL-DT (application dictates).
